subject: Planned EU-South service sanitization: staged node quiesce & driver alignment (Jul 9)
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-08T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Planned EU-South service sanitization: staged node quiesce & driver alignment (Jul 9)

Hi team,

We're scheduling a short maintenance window for eu-south on Friday, Jul 9 between 02:00 and 06:00 UTC to perform a phased service sanitization. This covers an aligned microcode/driver compatibility update plus a controlled node quiesce to validate threadpool and IO controller behavior under load.

Objectives:
- Align IO/controller microcode across host class B clusters
- Flush and validate tenant-level threadpool tuning changes
- Run live canaries to verify KV-cache warmup preserves latency SLOs

Plan (high level):
1) Canary cohort (2 hosts) — 02:00–02:30 UTC: run synthetic traffic, collect latency/regen metrics
2) Phase A groups (10% of capacity) — 02:30–03:30 UTC: nonblocking restart of driver module + threadpool tweak
3) Phase B groups (30% of capacity) — 03:30–04:45 UTC: staggered quiesce, verify KV cache rehydration
4) Reconciliation & extended observation — 04:45–06:00 UTC: rerun canaries, final validations

Expected customer impact: minimal. We anticipate short-lived connection resets for in-flight requests during host switchover (typically <5s). Long-running streaming sessions may need to reconnect; we will attempt graceful handoffs first. No tenant data will be migrated or modified outside normal runtime behavior.

Operational notes:
- We will autoscale to burst capacity in eu-north if we observe sustained latency regressions beyond thresholds.
- Opt-out: customers with strict affinity can request an exemption by emailing ops@redwood.com before 2027-07-08T18:00:00 UTC. Exemptions will be handled case-by-case and may necessitate manual scheduling.

Attachments: runbook and preliminary canary results (internal).

Please review the runbook and confirm the rollback signal thresholds (I listed two thresholds in the doc). Marissa — can you validate the KV-cache rehydration timeout we put in the runbook? Grace — I'll need your go/no-go at T-3 hours.

Thanks,
Avery

--

On Thu, Jul 8, 2027 at 09:02 AM Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com> wrote:
> We're scheduling a short maintenance window for eu-south on Friday, Jul 9 between 02:00 and 06:00 UTC to perform a phased service sanitization.

Couple clarifications from the runbook and canary runs attached:
- Long-running streams: the runtime will attempt a graceful handoff to warm replicas where available. If a handoff isn't possible we will surface a retriable error. SDKs are expected to reconnect; we will post an SDK guidance note for customers with streaming use-cases.
- Canary results (attached) show a transient 8–12% increase in tail latency for the first 3 minutes after a host switchover in synthetic load; p95 returns to baseline after our KV-cache rehydrate window (90s) in tests.
- Rollout pause condition: any sustained p95 delta >20% for 10 consecutive minutes OR error-rate spike >0.5% will trigger an automatic pause and rollback to previous driver revision.

I've updated the runbook to reflect a conservative rehydrate timeout (120s) and added a secondary validation step that p99 for canary must be below 450ms before we proceed to Phase B. See OPS-4521 for the play-by-play.

Attaching: canary-validation-results.csv (internal), updated runbook excerpt.

Marissa

--

Subject: Service notice: eu-south maintenance window (Jul 9) — brief customer advisory

Nimbus team —

We're performing a planned maintenance in eu-south on Jul 9 between 02:00–06:00 UTC to align controller microcode and validate threadpool tuning across a subset of hosts. Our testing shows low customer impact; you may see brief reconnects (<5s) for in-flight requests. Long-running streams can reconnect automatically; our SDK guidance is to retry on transient disconnects.

If you have strict affinity or cannot tolerate transient reconnects, please reply to this message before Jul 9 00:00 UTC and we'll evaluate an exemption.

Links: maintenance runbook (internal) — https://drive.redwood.com/shared/eu-south-maintenance-runbook
Jira: OPS-4521

Thanks for your cooperation, and apologies for any inconvenience. We'll send a post-maintenance summary with canary outcomes and any follow-ups required.
